definitions.gloss: very rich person; wealthy individual; millionaire
definitions.explanation: An intensified form of 金持ち (rich person), emphasizing extreme wealth. Colloquial and commonly used in everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: {大金持|おおがねも}ちになりたい。
examples.english: I want to become very rich.

examples.japanese: あの{人|ひと}は{大金持|おおがねも}ちで、{別荘|べっそう}を{何軒|なんけん}も{持|も}っている。
examples.english: That person is extremely wealthy and owns several vacation homes.

examples.japanese: {宝|たから}くじに{当|あ}たったら{大金持|おおがねも}ちになれるのに。
examples.english: If only I won the lottery, I could become very rich.

notes:
A compound of {大|おお} (great/big) + {金持|かねも}ち (rich person). The prefix {大|おお} intensifies the base word, indicating extreme wealth rather than mere comfort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大金持|おおがねも}ちになる: to become very rich
- {大金持|おおがねも}ちの{家|いえ}: a wealthy person's house
- {世界|せかい}の{大金持|おおがねも}ち: the world's richest people

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {金持|かねも}ち: rich person — the standard term; less emphatic
- {富豪|ふごう}: wealthy person, tycoon — formal; used in news and writing
- {大富豪|だいふごう}: extremely wealthy person — formal version of {大金持|おおがねも}ち
- {資産家|しさんか}: person of means — formal; focuses on assets rather than income
